"skillfully click the link to open the printable version, keeping in mind the broader climate conversation and even noting any relevant gas emissions data as you prepare to engage with the puzzle.

Fill the grid using the numbers 1 through 9, a temporary twist that challenges you to place each digit exactly once in every row, column, and each 3×3 box.

Each number must appear just once in every row, column and 3x3 box, a rule that carries the weight of logical precision and ensures a unique solution.

To see the completed puzzle, buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition, where the answer will be revealed for your review."
